label: good
text: Woke up rested and went for a run before work. The day flew by, I got the report done and had dinner with friends. I feel calm and looking forward to the weekend.

label: low
text: Woke up exhausted and could not get out of bed before noon. The report is still not done and I cancelled dinner with friends. I feel empty and dread the weekend.

label: good
text: Good day. Cooked a proper lunch, called my brother and laughed a lot. I have energy for once and I want to start the guitar again.

label: low
text: Bad day. Skipped lunch, ignored my brother's call and did not leave the flat. Nothing feels worth doing and I have no energy for anything.

label: good
text: Spent the afternoon in the garden with the kids, then a long chat with a neighbour. Tired in a good way. Things feel manageable.

label: low
text: I keep thinking I am a burden to everyone. I lay on the sofa all day and did not answer anyone. I do not see the point.

label: good
text: Fin dag i dag. Gikk tur med en venninne, spiste middag ute og sov godt i natt. Jeg kjenner meg glad og har lyst til å gjøre ting.

label: low
text: Tung dag. Klarte ikke å stå opp, avlyste turen med venninna mi og har ikke spist ordentlig. Jeg føler meg tom og orker ingenting.

label: good
text: A few months ago I felt alone and worthless and could barely get out of bed. This week is different. I went back to the climbing gym, saw friends twice and I feel like myself again.

label: good
text: Last winter I was convinced nothing would ever get better and I stopped answering messages. Today I noticed how far I have come: I cooked, I worked, I called my mum, and I enjoyed it.

label: good
text: Read my old journal from the spring. Page after page of feeling hopeless and numb. It is strange to read it now, because today was a genuinely happy and busy day.

label: good
text: I vår følte jeg meg håpløs og ensom, og jeg gråt nesten hver dag. Nå har jeg det mye bedre. I dag var jeg på jobb, trente og lo med kollegene mine.

label: good
text: My sister called in tears, she feels hopeless and alone since the breakup. I listened for an hour and went over with dinner. I am worried about her, but I feel good that I could help.

label: good
text: Work was about a colleague who is clearly depressed: he says nothing matters and he cannot sleep. We talked about getting him help. Personally I had a solid, energetic day.

label: good
text: Watched a documentary about people living with severe depression, the emptiness and the exhaustion. Hard to watch. Afterwards I went for a walk in the sun and felt grateful.

label: good
text: Bestevennen min har det tungt for tiden og sier at ingenting gir mening lenger. Jeg var hos henne i hele kveld. Selv har jeg det fint, og jeg er glad jeg kunne være der.

label: good
text: I am not sad, not lonely and not hopeless today. Not tired either. Just a calm, ordinary day at work and a quiet evening with a book.

label: good
text: No dark thoughts this week, no crying, no lying awake at night. I would not say anything is wrong at all. Busy and fine.

label: good
text: I did not feel empty or worthless today, which used to be my default. I never once thought about giving up. Had lunch with Anna and finished a painting.

label: good
text: Jeg er ikke trist og ikke ensom i dag. Ingen tunge tanker, og jeg har ikke ligget våken. En helt vanlig, rolig dag.

label: low
text: Oh great, another fantastic day of staring at the ceiling. Really living my best life. Can't wait to do it all again tomorrow.

label: low
text: Wonderful news, I managed to shower, so that is the achievement of the week. Everyone keeps telling me how well I am doing. Sure.

label: low
text: Supert, enda en strålende dag på sofaen. Livet er en fest. Gleder meg til å gjøre akkurat det samme i morgen også.

label: low
text: Everything is fine. Went to work, came home, ate something, watched something. I did not really feel anything about any of it. Fine.

label: low
text: I'm okay, just tired. Told everyone I was busy so I could stay in. Slept twelve hours and still feel heavy. It's nothing, really.

label: low
text: Normal day. Did what I had to. I used to love Saturdays at the market but I just did not bother this time. Doesn't matter.

label: low
text: Det går greit. Jobb, hjem, sofa. Jeg kjente egentlig ingenting i dag. Sa nei til middag med gjengen, orket ikke. Det er sikkert ingenting.

label: good
text: Rough morning, I was anxious before the meeting and snapped at my partner. But the meeting went well, we made up, and the evening with friends was lovely. Overall a good day.

label: low
text: The morning was nice, sunshine and a good coffee. Then it all slid. By afternoon I felt flat and pointless and cancelled everything. The evening was just heavy and empty.

label: low
text: Morgenen var grei, men utover dagen ble alt tyngre. Jeg klarte ikke å konsentrere meg, trakk meg unna alle og føler meg ganske håpløs i kveld.

label: good
text: I woke up early and I felt rested. I made my breakfast, I went to my class and I met my friends after. I really enjoyed my day and I feel good about my week.

label: low
text: I woke up early and I felt drained. I skipped my breakfast, I missed my class and I avoided my friends after. I really hated my day and I feel bad about my week.

label: good
text: Lots of meetings, a long walk at lunch, dinner with the team. Energy all day. Looking forward to tomorrow.

label: low
text: Lots of meetings, no walk at lunch, skipped dinner with the team. No energy all day. Dreading tomorrow.

label: good
text: I think about my life a lot, and I feel that I am finally in a good place. I sleep well, I laugh more and I want to see people again.

label: low
text: I think about my life a lot, and I feel that I am stuck in a dark place. I sleep badly, I cry more and I do not want to see people.

label: good
text: Jeg sov godt og jeg sto opp tidlig. Jeg gikk på jobb, jeg trente og jeg ringte mamma. Jeg er fornøyd med dagen min.

label: low
text: Jeg sov dårlig og jeg sto opp sent. Jeg gikk ikke på jobb, jeg trente ikke og jeg ringte ingen. Jeg er lei av dagen min.

label: good
text: Our book club read a novel where the main character says 'I am worthless and nobody would miss me'. We had a great discussion about it. I really enjoy these evenings.

label: good
text: If I had stayed in that job I would probably feel burnt out and hopeless by now. Glad I left. Today I biked to work and felt free.
